question: An opaque bag contains a total of 20 red and white balls, identical except for color. Each time, 1 ball is drawn, its color is recorded, and it is replaced. After a large number of repeated trials, the relative frequency of drawing a red ball is found to stabilize at 0.3. Estimate approximately how many red balls are in the bag.
solution: The probability of drawing a red ball is approximately 0.3, so the number of red balls is approximately \(20\times0.3=6\).
